title: DeMedia
description:
DeMedia redefines online opinions with the power of true anonymity, backed by the Anon-Aadhaar protocol. Say goodbye to fake reviews and biased ratings – our platform offers all the benefits of anonymity without the drawbacks. Share genuine opinions securely, conduct unbiased polls, and provide businesses with trustworthy feedback. It's the future of authentic, private, and meaningful online interactions. Welcome to a platform where your voice truly matters.

**Links**
- [https://github.com/De-Media/DeMedia-contracts](https://github.com/De-Media/DeMedia-contracts)
- [https://github.com/De-Media/frontend](https://github.com/De-Media/frontend)
how_its_made: Integrating the anon-aadhaar verifier with DeMedia contracts was a challenge. Had to deal with deprecated packages in the SDK. Needed to make changes in node_modules for resolution. Solidity limitations on array copying required significant debugging. The push protocol integration, especially channel creation, posed challenges
